chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, Allah the Exalted did not grant Satan authority over those who have faith.
But [He granted authority] over those who take him as their guardian and disobey His command.

key_terms.يَتَوَلَّوْنَهُمْ: Those who take him as guardian/ally

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for Satan having authority over believers according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq’s (a) clarification that Satan’s *sultan* (authority/power) is not inherent but contingent upon human free will and voluntary submission, a key distinction in Shia theology against predestination. This hadith underscores that while believers are not immune to Satan's whispers, they remain under his dominion only as long as they do not actively resist or obey his inclinations, thereby preserving the integrity of divine justice and human agency.
